annotations.title: Draft an email to a dealer or lender

description: Drafts an email to a dealer or lender from one of six Before the Lot templates: request an itemized out-the-door quote, make an offer, share a competing quote, confirm the deal, decline, or give a lender the deal's numbers. Returns a subject and body for the person to review and send from their own inbox; nothing is sent. Details are numbers and short labels; contact details are refused, and an offer over the walk line given isn't drafted.

details.description: What the email needs: the car, dealer, prices and loan terms. Leave out what does not apply

amount_to_finance.description: The amount to finance, for a lender

car.description: The car, like "2024 Honda CR-V EX"

out_the_door_price.description: An out-the-door price: the competing quote, or the agreed price to confirm

pre_approved.description: The buyer has a loan pre-approval

stock_or_vin.description: The dealer's stock number or the VIN

trade_equity.description: Trade-in value less what is owed on it (negative when more is owed)

walk_line.description: The walk line, out the door. The templates never state it; an offer above it is not drafted

kind.description: Which email: request-quote, make-offer, competing-quote, confirm-deal, decline, lender-deal

name: dealer_email
title: Draft an email to a dealer or lender
